message: You ever have one of those moments where you think you’re all set, and then life throws you a curveball? Last week, I was in the kitchen, feeling pretty proud of my smoke alarm system—until I accidentally set off the alarm while making toast. My family came running, and I couldn’t help but chuckle a bit as I thought, "I guess that’s my cue to check the escape plan again!" It reminded me how important it is to stay prepared, even when things seem under control. Do you have a household plan for fire safety? I'd love to hear what works for you!
